company: Công ty TNHH NGen
description:
## Company

NGen Company Limited (Công ty TNHH NGen) is a software publishing company based in Hanoi, with 10–24 employees. It develops and publishes mobile games for international markets.

## Details

- **Location:** Building G3, Vinhomes Greenbay Mễ Trì, Từ Liêm Ward, Nam Từ Liêm District, Hanoi
- **Level:** Staff
- **Experience:** 1 year
- **Education:** University degree or higher
- **Salary:** 10,000,000–25,000,000 VND, depending on ability
- **Work model:** On-site, full-time (Monday–Friday, 08:30–11:45 and 13:00–17:30)
- **Openings:** 1
- **Application deadline:** 19/11/2026

## Responsibilities

- **Level design for puzzle games:** Use Unity to build and design levels according to the defined features, gameplay, and difficulty.
- **Prototyping:** Quickly build prototypes in Unity to validate gameplay, mechanics, and game feel before they move into production.
- **Game analysis and optimization:** Playtest, evaluate gameplay, identify issues with difficulty, pacing, and game feel, and propose improvements.
- **Cross-team collaboration:** Work with developers, artists, animators, VFX/effects artists, and other game designers to complete gameplay and optimize game feel.
- **Product monitoring and updates:** Actively test game builds, collect feedback, and work with the team to improve product quality.
- **Market research:** Analyze games currently on the market, especially puzzle, hyper-casual, and casual titles, track trends, and propose new game ideas.

## Requirements / Qualifications

- Experience using Unity to design and build levels. Experience with puzzle or hybrid-casual games is preferred.
- At least 1 year of game design experience on the Unity platform, with a product or game prototype to demonstrate.
- Ability to design levels independently, from gameplay requirements through to implementation in Unity.
- Strong game sense: able to evaluate a game by identifying what works, what doesn't, why, and how to improve it.
- Passion for games, with regular play and exploration of different genres. Energetic, enjoys experimenting, and willing to build prototypes quickly to test ideas.
- Interest in a fast-paced startup environment that values initiative, with opportunities to work with overseas publishers and game studios.
- **Industry knowledge:** Games
- **Essential skills:** Unity, game design, level design, gameplay analysis, prototype development
- **Nice-to-have skills:** Puzzle games, hybrid-casual games

## Benefits

- Salary of 10,000,000–25,000,000 VND, depending on ability
- 13th-month bonus
- Revenue sharing and project bonuses
- Opportunity to take part in the full game development cycle, from idea to prototype, level design, production, soft launch, and product optimization
- Opportunities for professional growth in game design, level design, and product thinking
- A professional, creative work environment with an experienced team that has developed and published international mobile games
- Full statutory employee benefits under current Vietnamese law
- Company-provided computer
- Support allowance

description:
## Company

GENKI Tech Solutions Joint Stock Company is a software development company based in Ho Chi Minh City, with 25-99 employees. It operates in computer programming and provides Japanese-language communication support for software projects, connecting Japanese clients with Vietnamese development teams.

## Details

- **Location:** Ho Chi Minh City (office at 168 Cao Đức Lân, Bình Trưng Ward, Thủ Đức, former area)
- **Seniority/Level:** Team Lead (1 position); 2 years of experience required
- **Salary:** Negotiable
- **Work model:** Onsite or hybrid (office and remote)
- **Employment type:** Full-time

## Responsibilities

**Project interpretation and communication support**
- Interpret between Japanese and Vietnamese in meetings between Japanese clients and the Vietnamese development team.
- Help all parties clearly understand discussions on requirements, system design, schedules, testing, and technical issues.
- Translate project documents when needed.
- Coordinate with the PM, technical team, and Japanese clients throughout the project.
- Spend at least 50% of working time on verbal communication and meeting interpretation.

**Leading and developing the Comtor team (currently 3 members)**
- Set team goals based on project needs and individual members' roles; clarify quality expectations and track progress.
- Work with the PM/Team Leader to allocate tasks, balance workloads, and support members facing difficulties.
- Give specific feedback and evaluate work performance based on goals and actual results; follow up on improvement actions.
- Identify each member's strengths, areas for improvement, and development direction; provide guidance through real work.
- Improve processes, communication standards, and interpretation quality; encourage initiative, collaboration, and learning within the team.

**Using tools and AI**
- Use AI and other suitable tools to improve work efficiency.
- Guide team members to carefully check output quality and protect project confidential information when using these tools.

## Requirements / Qualifications

**Required**
- At least 2 years of experience as an IT Comtor or interpreter on IT projects.
- Fluent listening and speaking Japanese in a work environment; confident interpreting directly with Japanese clients.
- JLPT N5 certification in Japanese.
- University degree or higher.
- Understanding of software development terminology and processes; able to follow and clearly and accurately convey technical discussions.
- Experience leading, mentoring colleagues, or coordinating a team; able to set goals, give specific feedback, evaluate fairly, and support members in improving.
- Good listening skills, logical thinking, and problem-solving ability; proactive, responsible, and willing to learn.

**Nice to have**
- Previously served as a Team Lead, trainer, or mentor in an IT Comtor or Interpreter team.

description:
## Company

Air Information Technology and Telecommunications Joint Stock Company (AITS), founded on November 11, 2008, provides information technology, telecommunications, and digital transformation solutions. Its core offerings are technology innovation and digital transformation (IT and telecom), data analysis and processing, and technology consulting and transfer. Its target markets include aviation, travel and tourism, airports, oil and gas, construction and manufacturing, enterprises, banking, finance and insurance, defense and security, healthcare, government, logistics, and education. Its customers are domestic and international organizations with demanding requirements for infrastructure, security, and system availability.

## Details

- **Location:** Hanoi
- **Level:** 5 years of professional experience required
- **Salary:** Negotiable
- **Education:** University degree or higher

## Responsibilities

### 1. Architecture and Systems

**1.1 Product and service concept design**
- Research, propose, and design technology product and service ideas that can be commercialized in AITS's target markets.
- Analyze market problems, needs, and trends to identify opportunities for new products and services.
- Translate customer needs into: product concept, customer value proposition, functional scope, service delivery model, technology approach, and preliminary commercial plan.
- Assess technical feasibility, resources, cost, timeline, and commercial potential before recommending development.

**1.2 Product design using a lifecycle architecture**
- Directly design products and services across the product lifecycle, including:
  - Applications: software, platforms, business systems, AI, data, and digital applications.
  - Infrastructure: servers, storage, networking, cloud, security, equipment, and other necessary infrastructure components.

- Build the overall architecture and identify the components needed to form a complete product or service.
- Determine which components will be: developed in-house, integrated from the AITS ecosystem, purchased from vendors or partners, leased as services, or combined from multiple platforms and technologies.
- Design products for scalability, reuse, and customization across multiple customers and markets.
- Develop standardization approaches to reduce deployment time and increase replicability.

**1.3 Technology research and selection**
- Research emerging technology trends and assess their applicability to AITS products and services.
- Monitor trends including AI/ML/GenAI, cloud, big data and data analytics, cybersecurity, IoT and edge computing, automation, digital platforms, and smart airport and aviation technology.
- Evaluate technologies against criteria including: market fit, integration capability, stability, scalability, total cost of ownership and operating cost, security, and long-term ability to master and develop the technology.
- Recommend technologies and platforms aligned with AITS's product strategy.

**1.4 Product ecosystem design**
- Contribute to developing the m.AITS ecosystem around products and platforms.
- Define relationships, integration capabilities, and shared components among products and services.
- Propose ecosystem models that are modular, integrated, scalable, reusable, and capable of being commercialized independently or as solution packages.

### 2. Work Organization: Product Development Process

**2.1 Market research and survey**
- Research markets, technology trends, and customer needs.
- Survey similar products and services available in the market.
- Analyze competitors and alternative solutions.
- Benchmark products and services from domestic and international technology companies.
- Analyze customer pain points, market needs, technology trends, competitive advantages, and business opportunities.
- Identify opportunities for new products or improvements to existing

company: Công ty CPĐT Hoàng Đạo (Zodiac)
description:
## Company

Công ty CPĐT Hoàng Đạo (Zodiac) is a Vietnamese company with 100–499 employees, operating in electrical system installation. Its office is in Cầu Giấy, Hà Nội.

## Details

- **Location:** Zodiac Tower, 11th floor, No. 1, Lane 19 Duy Tân, Dịch Vọng Hậu ward, Cầu Giấy district, Hà Nội
- **Seniority/Level:** Staff (Nhân viên)
- **Salary:** 15–20 million VND
- **Experience:** 2 years
- **Education:** College degree or higher
- **Work model:** On-site (office-based), full-time
- **Working hours:** Monday–Friday, 08:00–17:30
- **Application deadline:** 10/12/2026

## Responsibilities

- Manage, operate, and maintain network infrastructure (LAN, WAN, VPN, Wi-Fi, firewall) to ensure stable and continuous operation.
- Install, configure, manage, and support hardware devices, including computers, laptops, printers, peripherals, and other office equipment, and assist end users with them.
- Install, configure, manage, and troubleshoot system software (Windows Client, basic Linux), office software (Microsoft Office 365, Google Workspace), and internal applications.
- Manage and support server systems (Windows Server, Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, File Server), ensuring security and performance.
- Perform regular and on-request data backup and recovery, ensuring data integrity.
- Analyze and resolve incidents and faults in network, hardware, software, and other IT-related technical issues.
- Propose solutions to improve the performance, security, and optimization of IT systems.
- Provide helpdesk technical support to end users for IT-related issues, ensuring timely and effective resolution.
- Monitor, supervise, and report on the operational status of IT systems, and detect and address potential risks early.

## Requirements / Qualifications

- At least 2 years of experience in IT Technical, IT Support, or equivalent positions.
- College or university degree in Information Technology, Computer Networking, Information Systems, or a related field.
- In-depth knowledge of network infrastructure (TCP/IP, LAN/WAN, routers, switches, firewalls) and the ability to configure common network devices.
- Experience with Windows Client (Windows 10/11) and Windows Server (2016, 2019, 2022).
- Understanding of and experience managing Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, and Group Policy.
- Skills in installing, configuring, maintaining, and troubleshooting computer, laptop, and printer hardware.
- Experience with office software such as Microsoft Office 365 and Google Workspace.
- Basic knowledge of system security, information security, and antivirus solutions.
- Logical thinking and the ability to analyze and solve technical problems effectively.
- High sense of responsibility, proactivity, and the ability to work both independently and in a team.
- Good communication skills and the ability to guide and support users.
- Preferred: experience with virtualization (VMware, Hyper-V) or with IP camera or IP PBX (telephony) systems.

## Benefits

- Competitive, attractive salary, negotiable based on candidate's ability and experience.
- Full social insurance, health insurance, and unemployment insurance contributions in accordance with current law.
- Holiday and Tết bonuses, a 13th-month salary, and other performance-based bonuses.
- Opportunities for professional training and participation in IT-related courses and certifications.
- Professional, dynamic, and friendly work environment with clear career development opportunities.
- Annual team-building activities and company trips.
- Annual periodic health check-ups and other welfare policies.

- Design, develop, and optimize web applications and APIs using .NET Core / .NET 6+.

- Participation in annual company trips and employee engagement activities.

company: CTY TNHH KHÔNG HẢI VẬN
description:
## Company

CTY TNHH KHÔNG HẢI VẬN is a company of 25–99 employees operating in support services related to transport and logistics.

## Details

- **Location:** 5 Đống Đa, Tân Sơn Hòa Ward (formerly Tân Bình District), Ho Chi Minh City
- **Seniority/Level:** Staff
- **Salary:** 12–16 million VND per month (negotiable based on competence), plus performance bonuses/KPIs
- **Work model:** Full-time, on-site
- **Working hours:** Monday to Friday, 08:00–17:30
- **Experience:** 1 year
- **Openings:** 1

## Responsibilities

This is a part-time IT role combined with internal communications and branding.

**IT Infrastructure & Software Operations**
- Monitor, maintain, and troubleshoot computers, printers, the internal network (LAN/Wi-Fi), cameras, and other office equipment on a regular basis.
- Manage and monitor the operation of the company's business software; help staff resolve software errors and install applications.
- Optimize data storage systems and perform data backups to ensure information security.
- Administer the company email system, ensuring it is secure, reliable, and running smoothly, and resolve internal email issues.

**Accounting Data & Reporting Support (Excel)**
- Build, standardize, and optimize Excel templates and reports for the Accounting department to track receivables/payables, revenue, and expenses.
- Process data, set up calculation formulas, and automate Excel tasks to reduce the time needed to extract receivables data.

**Branding, Content Writing & Website Management**
- Collect, photograph, and archive images and videos of company events, activities, and daily operations.
- Write content, communications articles, and PR pieces for the company website and social media channels.
- Manage and coordinate with technical partners to upgrade and maintain the website's design and features.
- Edit, create basic designs for, and standardize the company's brand materials, including company profiles, brochures, catalogs, and banners.

## Requirements / Qualifications

**Education & Experience**
- Vocational secondary degree or higher (per the posting header). The job description specifies a college or university degree in Information Technology, Information Systems, Multimedia Communications, or a related field.
- 1–2 years of experience as an IT Support or IT Helpdesk specialist, or in a combined IT–Marketing role.

**Technical Skills**
- Advanced Excel skills: proficient in calculation and lookup functions (VLOOKUP, INDEX-MATCH, PivotTables, IF, etc.), with an analytical approach to accounting receivables data.
- IT skills: understanding of hardware, computer networks, and troubleshooting office software.
- Branding & content skills: strong writing and editing ability, basic photography skills, and good aesthetic sense.
- Tools: basic proficiency with design and photo-editing software (Photoshop, Canva, Illustrator, etc.) and experience managing a CMS website (e.g., WordPress).

**Attitude & Personal Qualities**
- Careful and detail-oriented in handling data and managing equipment.
- Quick-thinking, highly responsible, and proactive in supporting other departments.

## Benefits

- Competitive salary (12–16 million VND/month, negotiable based on competence) plus performance bonuses and KPI-based incentives.
- Full social insurance, health insurance, and unemployment insurance, in accordance with the Labor Law.
- 13th-month salary bonus, holiday and Tết bonuses, an annual company trip, and team-building activities (subject to the company's business performance).
- A dynamic, open work environment where you can develop a range of skills across technical, data, and creative areas.

description:
## Company

Trường Đại học Đông Đô (Dong Do University) is a higher-education institution in Hanoi, located at 60B Nguyễn Huy Tưởng, Thanh Xuân ward. It has 100–499 employees.

- **Location:** Hà Nội (Thanh Xuân ward, former Thanh Xuân district), with work covering the wider area
- **Seniority/Level:** Staff (Nhân viên)
- **Salary:** 12–15 million VND
- **Work model:** On-site (office), full-time, with working hours flexible according to the teaching timetable

## Responsibilities

Teaching, research, academic advising (if assigned), curriculum development, textbook writing, community service, and other duties assigned by the Board of Management, Faculty leadership, or Department heads, suited to the lecturer's abilities and competence, including:

a) Teach assigned courses, ensuring compliance with the curriculum, schedule, learning outcomes, and the University's academic regulations.

b) Prepare lectures, lesson plans, and learning materials, and update course content as required by the Faculty and the University.

c) Monitor and assess students, grade assignments, enter grades, and take part in invigilation and exam grading as assigned.

d) Take part in scientific research, seminars, and professional writing or other academic activities as required by the Faculty.

đ) Take part in training management work, including academic advising and supervising graduation theses or internships (if assigned).

e) Carry out other tasks assigned by the Dean and the Board of Management.

## Requirements / Qualifications

- **Education:** Master's degree or higher
- **Field of study:** Information Technology, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Systems, or related fields
- **Experience:** At least 1 year of teaching experience at universities or colleges

- **Salary:** 12–20 million VND
- **Work model:** On-site (office-based), full-time
- **Working hours:** Monday to Friday, 8:00 to 17:00
- **Number of openings:** 1

## Responsibilities

The Project Assistant (Back-End) is responsible for managing the complete set of documents and records for the Center's projects, from bid preparation and contract execution through acceptance and liquidation. The role also serves as the point of contact for the Center's internal administrative and logistics work, to keep the Center running efficiently and in compliance with regulations.

**1. Bid Documentation and Bidding (Project preparation stage)**
- Serve as the point of contact for gathering information and preparing the company profile, legal documents, financial documents, and other administrative materials required by the bidding documents (HSMT).
- Coordinate with the technical and solutions teams to compile and finalize the technical and financial proposals.
- Carry out bid submission procedures, submit bid documents, track bid opening results, and clarify bid documents when requested by the Investor or the Bidding Party.
- Liaise with the Finance and Accounting department to open bid guarantees at the bank on time.

**2. Contract Management and Monitoring (Implementation stage)**
- Coordinate with the Legal, Investment, and partner/Investor teams to draft and review the terms of the economic contract after a bid is won.
- Prepare and maintain a tracking schedule for contract execution, including delivery timelines, implementation milestones, payment milestones, and expiry dates of performance guarantees.
- Receive and draft submissions and official letters to the Investor or supplier regarding contract adjustments, extensions, or issues arising during implementation.

**3. Acceptance, Payment, and Contract Liquidation (Closing stage)**
- Work with the project technical team and partners to prepare handover minutes and acceptance records (installation acceptance, operational acceptance, and overall commissioning/trial-run acceptance).
- Assemble the complete set of payment documents required by the contract (invoices, acceptance records, certificates of origin CO/CQ, warranty guarantees, etc.) and send them to the Accounting department to process payment requests or make payments to subcontractors.
- Draft contract liquidation minutes, complete the procedures to return performance and warranty guarantees, and close the project file.

**4. Project Document Management**
- Establish a systematic filing system for all project documents, covering both hard copies at the office and soft copies on the shared data system.
- Ensure documents are secure, easy to retrieve, and legally complete, to support audits, inspections, or reconciliation when required.

**5. Center Administration**
- Manage official correspondence: receive, sort, route, and file incoming and outgoing official letters, submissions, and internal decisions of the Center.
- Office logistics: book taxis; manage and issue stationery, work equipment, and tools to Center staff.
- Internal events: support coordination and logistics for meetings, workshops, client visits, and internal engagement or communication activities.
- Attendance and benefits: support tracking of working days and leave schedules, and coordinate with the HR department on employee benefits for Center staff.

**6. Other Duties**
- Perform other tasks as directly assigned by the Center Director.

## Requirements / Qualifications

**Education**
- University degree or higher in a relevant field.

**Experience**
- At least 1 year of experience in an equivalent position.
- Experience in bidding in the telecommunications, IT, or low-voltage electrical sectors is preferred.

**Hard Skills**
- Proficient in office software

company: Công ty Cổ phần Vulcan Labs
description:
## Company

Vulcan Labs (Công ty Cổ phần Vulcan Labs) is a mobile application development company based in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam. Founded in 2017, it has published over 30 mobile applications with over 10 million downloads. The company is now expanding into web frontends that connect with its mobile apps and AI-driven features.

## Details

- **Location:** Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
- **Seniority/Level:** Employee (3+ years of experience)
- **Salary:** Negotiable
- **Work model:** On-site (office-based), full-time
- **Work schedule:** Monday to Friday, 09:00 to 18:00
- **Openings:** 1

## Responsibilities

- Communicate directly with Product Managers to clarify requirements and edge cases.
- Build frontend features in our Next.js (App Router) monorepo, following our shared architecture, workspace tiering, and design-token conventions.
- Partner with the Design team to implement UI/UX faithfully using our internal design system, including density and device-mode variants.
- Partner with QA to define testable behavior, including data-testid conventions, unit tests (Vitest), and E2E coverage (Playwright).
- Integrate with backend services via our BFF/route-handler layer, including SSE-based streaming for AI features.
- Collaborate with the team to analyze product needs and propose technical solutions, including trade-offs and risks.
- Work within agile/scrum processes and deliver on schedule at an acceptable quality bar.
- Write clear technical documentation for features, decisions, and non-obvious implementation choices.
- Track, analyze, and resolve production issues, including working with error-tracking tooling.
- Be a team player: put the team ahead of yourself and stay adaptable as priorities shift.

## Requirements / Qualifications

**Must have:**

- University degree or higher.
- 3+ years of professional experience as a Frontend Engineer.
- Strong experience with React and Next.js (App Router), including SSR/CSR trade-offs.
- Proficient in TypeScript for day-to-day development, not just typed function signatures.
- Experience with a modern state-management approach (Zustand, Jotai, Redux, or equivalent) and a data-fetching/cache library (React Query/TanStack Query or equivalent).
- Solid CSS fundamentals and experience with a utility-first framework (Tailwind CSS) and/or component libraries (shadcn/ui or similar).
- Comfortable with Git in a team workflow (feature branches, PR review, rebasing).
- Strong fundamentals in HTML5, CSS, and modern JavaScript/ES202x.
- Writes structured, well-documented, maintainable, and testable code.

**Nice to have:**

- Experience working inside a monorepo (Turborepo, Nx, or similar) with bun/pnpm/yarn workspaces.
- Experience with automated testing: Vitest/Jest for unit tests, Playwright/Cypress for E2E.
- Experience consuming or building a design-token pipeline (Style Dictionary or similar) and theming with CSS custom properties.
- Experience with feature flags in production (e.g., Firebase Remote Config, LaunchDarkly).
- Experience with headless CMS integration.
- Comfortable using AI coding assistants (Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot) as part of the daily workflow.
- Familiar with Jira for task management.
- Good understanding of networking/internetworking protocols (HTTP caching, WebSockets/SSE).
- Passionate about applying best practices and raising the bar on code quality across the team.

description:
## Company

Mobio Vietnam Software Application Joint Stock Company is a Vietnamese software company that develops and sells its products as Software as a Service (SaaS). Its main product is a Customer Data Platform (CDP) that consolidates and analyzes customer data to optimize and automate Marketing, Sales, and Service workflows. Its three product lines are Activation CDP (digital marketing), Smart CRM (sales and service teams), and Analytic CDP (data engineers and data scientists). Its customers are mainly large enterprises in banking, financial services, insurance, healthcare, and retail.

## Details

- **Location:** Hanoi. Office: HL Building, No. 6, Lane 82 Duy Tân, Cầu Giấy Ward, Hanoi
- **Seniority/Level:** Mid-level (DevOps Engineer, with a stated path to Senior)
- **Salary:** Negotiable (listed as 400–500 million VND gross per year in the benefits section)
- **Work model:** On-site. Monday to Friday, 09:00–18:00, plus one Saturday per month at the start of the month

## Responsibilities

Mobio offers its software on a subscription basis, but most large customers, especially banks, require deployment on infrastructure they manage. The same product must therefore run reliably on four deployment models: SaaS, On-Premise, Hybrid, and Cloud Native. Some environments have no internet access and strict security constraints. The product also ships a new version every two weeks, while the number of On-Premise installations keeps growing.

The DevOps Engineer is directly responsible for keeping the platform running correctly and reliably. This covers building and operating Kubernetes clusters and data services, maintaining the delivery pipeline from code to customer environments, maintaining monitoring that accurately reflects system health, and handling infrastructure incidents.

This is not a role that only follows instructions. The company expects you to identify manual steps and proactively propose ways to eliminate them. Over time, you will take on more responsibility for design, standardization, and handover, which is the path to Senior.

The role sits in the DevOps Team, which builds and owns the infrastructure platform and packages its processes, tools, and documentation for handover. Success is measured by whether team members or customers can operate what you hand over without you.

You will also work with:
- **Development Teams:** receive requests for environments, pipelines, and resources, and give feedback on designs that are hard to operate (for example, missing health probes, logs that are hard to search, or hard-coded configuration).
- **Solution Delivery Team:** provide technical support during customer-impacting incidents, deploy new installations, assess customer infrastructure, and travel domestically or internationally when needed.

**1. Operating and deploying the Kubernetes platform and data services (35%)**
- Build new Kubernetes clusters and operate running clusters (nodes, workloads, resources, certificates, version upgrades).
- Operate data services outside the cluster: MongoDB, Kafka, Elasticsearch, PostgreSQL, StarRocks, HDFS, Qdrant, and NFS (configuration, capacity expansion, troubleshooting).

description:
## Company

MekongAI Co., Ltd. is a software publishing company based in Da Nang, Vietnam, with 10–24 employees. It develops AI and large language model (LLM) technology.

## Details

- **Location:** 38 Dương Thị Xuân Quý, Ngũ Hành Sơn Ward, Da Nang, Vietnam
- **Level:** Internship
- **Salary:** Up to 4 million VND
- **Work model:** On-site (office-based)
- **Employment type:** Internship; flexible full-time or part-time schedule for students
- **Working hours:** Monday to Friday, 08:00–17:00
- **Education:** University degree or higher
- **Experience:** None required
- **Openings:** 4
- **Application deadline:** 30/11/2026

## Responsibilities

1. **RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) system research and development**
   - Help build and improve RAG systems for knowledge retrieval and document-based question answering.
   - Build data processing pipelines covering document processing, chunking, embedding, and storage in vector databases.
   - Research and experiment with retrieval methods, hybrid search, and reranking to improve retrieval quality.
   - Evaluate the quality of LLM retrieval and answers, analyze failure cases, and propose improvements.

2. **LLM research and fine-tuning**
   - Research and select open-source LLMs suited to each application.
   - Collect, clean, standardize, and build training data for LLMs.
   - Take part in fine-tuning experiments using SFT, LoRA/QLoRA, PEFT, and other suitable methods.
   - Develop model evaluation methods, analyze results, and improve data or training strategies.

3. **AI applications in cybersecurity**
   - Research and apply RAG and LLMs in cybersecurity, supporting the analysis of security documents, vulnerability information, and related technical data.

## Requirements / Qualifications

**Foundational knowledge**
- Basic knowledge of Python, machine learning/deep learning, Transformers, and LLMs.
- Understanding of how RAG, embeddings, vector databases, and basic LLM fine-tuning methods work.
- Ability to read and understand English technical documentation, documentation, and source code.

**Nice to have**
- Experience with personal projects, research, or experiments involving RAG or LLM fine-tuning.
- Experience with PyTorch, Hugging Face, LangChain/LlamaIndex, PEFT, Qdrant, ChromaDB, or equivalent frameworks.
- Basic knowledge of cybersecurity, including OWASP, CVE/CWE, web/API security, or penetration testing.
- A GitHub profile or real products that demonstrate technical ability.

**Mindset and work ethic**
- Analytical and problem-solving mindset, with the ability to self-study and research new technologies.
- Ability to form hypotheses, design experiments, evaluate results, and propose improvements.
- Focus on understanding the underlying principles and how things work, not just using tools or frameworks.
- Proactive, responsible, and open to feedback.

**Industry:** IT – Software; Cybersecurity

**Required skills:** Python, Machine Learning, Training, Deep Learning, Transformers, Tokenization, Attention

**Preferred skills:** AI, English, LLM, API Security, Web Security

## Benefits

- Training and direct guidance from experienced mentors.
- Hands-on work on a real LLM research and development project, rather than simulated exercises only.
- Opportunity to become a full-time employee based on good performance.
- Flexible schedule for students, so internship hours can fit around classes.
- Young, open startup culture that encourages hypothesis testing and trying new approaches.
- Allowance of up to 4 million VND.
- Lunch allowance of 40,000 VND per day.

title: NodeJS Backend (TeamLead)
company: TECHVIFY SOFTWARE., JSC
description:
## Company

TECHVIFY SOFTWARE., JSC is a computer programming company with 100–499 employees. Its headquarters is in the HUDTower Building, 37 Le Van Luong Street, Thanh Xuan District, Hanoi.

## Details

- **Location:** Truong Chinh Street, Tan Binh Ward, Ho Chi Minh City
- **Seniority/Level:** Team Lead
- **Salary:** Negotiable
- **Work model:** On-site (office), full-time, Monday to Friday, 09:00–18:00

## Responsibilities

- Design, build, and maintain backend services in NodeJS with NestJS, following the existing microservice architecture and conventions.
- Define and version REST/GraphQL APIs consumed by the Flutter mobile app and by other internal services, including contract-first specs and backward compatibility.
- Model data across a polyglot persistence layer: relational databases for transactional consistency, and NoSQL for high-volume or flexible-schema workloads. Write and tune queries, design indexes, and handle migrations safely.
- Implement inter-service communication patterns (synchronous HTTP/gRPC and asynchronous messaging/event-driven) with attention to idempotency, retries, and failure isolation.
- Containerize services and support their deployment to AWS EKS. Work with Helm charts or equivalent manifests, resource limits, health probes, and autoscaling configuration.
- Build and maintain GitLab CI/CD pipelines covering automated tests, static analysis, security scanning, image build, and deployment stages across environments.
- Write unit and integration tests, and maintain meaningful coverage on business-critical paths.
- Instrument services with logging, metrics, and tracing. Participate in incident response, root cause analysis, and follow-up fixes.
- Take part in code review, technical design discussions, and estimation. Document decisions.
- Work directly with client-side stakeholders in English across time zones.

## Requirements / Qualifications

- At least 2 years of work experience.
- University degree or higher.
- At least 2 years of experience with NodeJS or a comparable structured framework.
- Hands-on experience in a microservice environment, including service decomposition, API contracts, distributed data, and the operational trade-offs involved.
- Solid relational database skills (PostgreSQL or MySQL), including schema design, transactions, and query optimization. Practical experience with at least one NoSQL store (MongoDB, DynamoDB, Redis, or similar) and a clear understanding of when to use each.
- Working knowledge of Docker and Kubernetes. Able to read and modify manifests, debug a failing pod, and understand how a service reaches production.
- Experience with AWS services in day-to-day development, including EKS and any of ECR, S3, RDS, SQS/SNS, Secrets Manager, or CloudWatch.
- Experience maintaining CI/CD pipelines, ideally GitLab CI.
- Strong Git workflow discipline and code review habits.
- English proficiency sufficient for written and spoken technical discussion with an overseas team.

## Benefits

- Join a global team and work directly with talented people around the world.
- Work and grow with a passionate, young, and talented team.
- Premium health insurance (TECHVIFY Care).
- 13 months' salary per year.
- Annual salary review.
- Company sponsorship for courses, covering tuition fees for platforms such as Udemy and Coursera.

- Internal management: HRM, Recruit, Marketing, Process, Site, Finance

- **Work model:** On-site (office), full-time
- **Working hours:** Monday–Friday, 08:30–17:45

## Responsibilities

The Solution Consultant is responsible for the full lifecycle of implementing the Cogover platform for customers, from current-state assessment and solution design through system configuration, testing, and go-live handover. The role combines business analysis with data design and platform configuration (Solution Configurator).

**Discovery and current-state analysis (Phase 1)**
- Interview customer departments (Sales, Warehouse/Logistics, Accounting, Marketing, Customer Service) to document current processes and pain points.
- Prepare an analysis of the current systems and their limitations.
- Determine the priority order for digitization and the customer's success criteria.
- Draft the Solution Proposal using Cogover's standard template.

**Solution design and data architecture (Phase 2)**
- Design Objects (equivalent to database schema design): define entities, Lookup relationships (Normal/Dependency), and select appropriate field types from Cogover's 20+ field types.
- Design BPMN processes: determine flow types (Triggered/Manual/Scheduled/Sequence), and map out nodes and conditional branches.
- Design the permission matrix: roles, CRUD rights for each Object, and data security rules.
- Prepare a detailed design document for customer sign-off before configuration begins.

**Configuration and system setup (Phase 3)**
- Create Objects, configure Fields, and use the Layout Builder (drag-and-drop) for create forms and view/edit forms.
- Set up UI Rules (show/hide fields based on conditions), Transition Rules (status changes), and Duplicate Rules (duplicate detection).
- Enable Field Change History for key status fields (e.g., Lead status, Opportunity stage, Order status, Ticket status).
- Configure BPMN workflows: Triggered Flows (run automatically when a record changes), Manual Flows (request forms), and Scheduled Flows (run on a schedule).
- Set up Assignment Rules, document templates, automated notifications, and email integration.
- Connect Omnichannel channels (Facebook, Zalo, TikTok, Shopee) and configure Service features (call center, IVR, ACD) where the project requires them.
- Configure Inventory where applicable: multi-warehouse setup, outbound strategies (FIFO/LIFO/FEFO), lot/serial tracking, and supply routes.

**Testing, data migration, and handover (Phases 4–5)**
- Run end-to-end tests of each business process using the customer's real data.
- Guide and support data migration from legacy systems (via the Cogover API or Excel import).
- Adjust configuration based on feedback from actual end users.
- Provide hands-on support for

### 3D Optimization and Mobile Platforms
- Standardize optimization workflows using Unity Profiler, Frame Debugger, and Memory Profiler. Apply GPU Instancing, Skinned Mesh merging, LOD, SRP/URP Batcher, Occlusion Culling, and Overdraw control for large-scale battle scenes.

5. **Coordination and improvement**
